patterns.note: Oversized typographic elements serve as primary visual anchors and section dividers, dominating the page's visual hierarchy.
A single, extremely bold and condensed sans-serif typeface is used for the main brand name and section titles, creating a strong, almost architectural visual identity.
A warm, muted beige background provides a soft, sophisticated contrast to the dark, heavy typography and vibrant imagery.

The hero section features a large, brand-name text element and a central image that parallax and move upwards at a slightly slower rate than the page scroll, eventually animating out of view to reveal the main content.
The top navigation transforms from a larger, more spread-out state to a compact, sticky bar with smaller text and a page indicator dot upon scrolling down.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width sections, each introduced by a large, bold typographic heading that acts as a visual landmark.

technique_notes: A sticky header is implemented that dynamically reduces its height, font size, and letter spacing, and adds a subtle active page indicator dot when the user scrolls past the initial hero section.

The hero section utilizes a scroll-triggered animation (likely using webgl-three or css-keyframes) where a large, dominant text element and a central image move upwards at a slightly slower rate than the page scroll, creating a parallax effect, eventually animating out of view to reveal the main content.
Content sections are presented with a clean, minimal layout, using large typographic headings to define each area, often with a full-bleed image or a grid of related content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold, condensed sans-serif for hero and section titles (~8-10x body text), with a clear hierarchy down to smaller, readable sans-serif for body copy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on the hero image container and the email input field; otherwise, sharp corners dominate the design.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in the hero section, balanced and comfortable for body text, with generous vertical spacing between major content blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive use of massive, bold typography as both a hero element and primary section dividers, combined with a subtle parallax scroll effect, creates a powerful, editorial, and almost architectural feel that elevates the content beyond a typical celebrity portfolio.
